scenes.title: Architecture, made visible.
sentences: Here is EARN on Solana in two minutes.
We will follow the system design, from the browser to liquidity pools.
And separate that architecture from this repository's new example code.

scenes.title: A familiar interface. A defined boundary.
sentences: The homepage and vault app use React and TypeScript, served through Cloudflare Workers.
The user's wallet approves and signs transactions.
The Worker provides the RPC gateway, market statistics, and Keeper status.

scenes.title: From USDC to vault shares.
sentences: A deposit starts with USDC.
The app converts it into the selected asset pair and deposits it in one atomic transaction.
The vault program issues shares and manages liquidity through Meteora DAMM V2.
Redemption burns shares and returns the underlying asset plus USDC.

scenes.title: Daily decisions. Explicit execution rules.
sentences: Keeper coordination lives in a separate Durable Object for each network and vault.
Each vault has one daily strategy slot, in the UTC zero cycle.
A signed transaction is journaled and submitted once.
Pending signatures are checked every forty-five seconds.
Failure or expiry waits for the next daily decision.
Fee-only reinvestment requires ten USDC in combined unclaimed fees.

scenes.title: Resilient reads. Controlled submissions.
sentences: RPC traffic uses a primary Helius provider, a standby, and a public endpoint.
Read failover never means replaying a submitted Keeper transaction.
Homepage market caching is only for display.
Accounting and execution use chain state, while idle app pages avoid polling.

scenes.title: Shared logic. Separate authority roles.
sentences: Mainnet and Devnet share program logic, with separate identities and execution policies.
Each network currently publishes six live vaults, and the registry can grow.
Management can independently pause deposits, withdrawals, or strategy investment.
Compatible upgrades preserve existing program and account identities.

scenes.title: Fresh code. A clear system map.
sentences: The diagram maps the Meteora DAMM V2 architecture.
This repository's website and Rust counter are fresh starter examples.
Explore the source, tests, and architecture on GitHub.
